book.name: Matiu
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Matiu Le Rorori

content: Jisas i ru Jerusalem
Jisas na gharaghambu vama thɨ vurɨthaiya Jerusalem, thɨ mena Betepage, Olivɨ ghanji Ou ghembaniye regha; amba i variyeŋgiya gharaghambu thenjighewo e ghamwanji,
iŋa, “Hu wa na vou ru e ghembana e ghamwamina. Ne hu thuweya doŋɨki regha thɨ ŋgarɨghathɨ weiye nariye. Hu raka ghathiyona na hu vaŋguma weiye nariyena.
Thoŋgo lolo regha i vaitoŋga, hu dagewe huŋa, ‘Giya nuwaiya,’ na tene i variyeŋgi e mbaŋako iyako.”
Iyake va i yomara na i vaemunjoruŋa Loi ghalɨŋae gharautu ghalɨŋae iya iŋake:

content.text: Wo hu thuwe, lemi kiŋ maiya i ghaona weŋga.
Iye ghathanavu i ghenenja, i tha e doŋɨki, i tha doŋɨki nariye e vwatae.

content: Gharaghambuma thɨ wa na vethɨ vakatha ŋgoreiya me dagema weŋgi.
Thɨ vaŋgumenaŋgiya doŋɨkima na nariye, thɨ bigiraweya ghanjikwama ghayaboyabo nariye e vwatae na Jisas i tha.
Wabwi laghɨye thɨ tateŋgiya ghanjikwama e kamwathɨko mara na vavana thɨ tenɨŋgiya umbwaumbwa ndamwandamwae na thɨ bigirawe.
Gharɨgharɨko iyava thɨ rakavivako na thiyeko iyava thɨ rakareghambako thɨ kula, thɨŋa:

content.text: Loi gharewe iya i mena Giya e idae!
Hosana! Ra taraweŋa Loi, iye i mevoro moli!

content: Mbaŋa Jisas i ru Jerusalem, gharɨgharɨko wolaghɨye gharenji i tagathɨn na thɨ vaito, thɨŋa, “Thelako?”
Wabwima thɨ gonjogha weŋgi, thɨŋa, “Loi ghalɨŋae gharautu, Jisas, i mena Nasaret, Galili ghembaniye regha.”
Jisas i ru e Ŋgolo Boboma tɨne
Jisas i ru e Ŋgolo Boboma ghayayao tɨne na i vagege raŋgiyaŋgiya rakunekune, i mwanavevewoŋgiya yao gharaten lenji tebol na tembe ŋgoreiyeva thiye va thɨ vakuneŋaŋgiya bunebune, lenji ghamba yaku.
I dage weŋgi iŋa, “Thɨ rori Buk Boboma e tɨne Loi iŋa, ‘Lo ŋgoloke ne thɨ una idae ŋgolo ghamba naŋgo,’ ko iyemaeŋge ghemi hu vakatha ŋgoreiya rakaivɨ lenji ghamba kubaro.”
Gharɨgharɨ maramaranji i kwaghe na vavana gheghenji thiya tharɨ thɨ rakamenawe e Ŋgolo Bobomako tɨne na i thawariŋgi.

Ko mbaŋa ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye na mbaro gharavavaghare thɨ thuwe vakathako thovuye i vakathaŋgi na gamagai thɨ kulakula e Ŋgolo Bobomako tɨne, thɨŋa, “Hosana! Ra taraweŋa Deivid Rumbuye,” gharenji i gaithɨwana Jisas.

Thɨ dagewe, thɨŋa, “Thare u loŋwe, ŋgoroŋga gamagaiko thɨŋa?” Jisas i gonjogha weŋgi, iŋa, “Ŋgoreiye. Mbe hu ndevaona mun bukuke iya iŋake, ‘O Loi, u vavaghareŋgiya gamagai na mbala gamagai nanasiye thɨ taraweŋaŋge.’”
Jisas i iteteŋgi na i raŋgi Jerusalem e tɨne, i wa Betani ve ghenawe.
Jisas i gura umbwa idae fig
Mbaŋambaŋa moli Jisas i njogha Jerusalem. E kamwathɨ mborowa bada i gharɨ.

I thuweya umbwa regha e kamwathɨko ghadidiye, idae fig, i ru na i yanyi, ko iyemaeŋge ma e uneune mbe ndamwandamwae eŋge. I dage weya umbwama iŋa, “Ma tene mbaŋa reghava u rau!” E mbaŋako iyako umbwama i mareyawowo.
Mbaŋa gharaghambu thɨ thuwe gharenji i yo. Thɨ vaito, thɨŋa, “Me ŋgoroŋga na umbwako le mare i maya?”

Jisas i gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Ya dage emunjoru e ghemi, thoŋgo hu loŋweghathɨ na ma hu numoghegheiwo, valɨkaiwamiya hu vakatha ŋgoreiya ma vakatha weya umbwako. Ma mbe iyako eŋge, valɨkaiwamiya ne hu dage weya ou, ‘U wa na vo dobu e njighɨko tɨne,’ ne i vakatha ŋgoreiye.
Thoŋgo hu loŋweghathɨ, the bigiya ne hu naŋgo weya Loi ne hu vaidi.”
Thɨ vaito Jisas le vurɨgheghe rɨghe

Mbaŋa Jisas i ru e Ŋgolo Boboma ghayayao tɨne na i vavaghare, ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye na randevivaŋgi thɨ menawe na thɨ vaito, thɨŋa, “U vata thela ele mbaro vwatae na u vakathaŋgiya bigibigike thiyake? Thela i giya vurɨgheghe e ghen?”

Jisas i gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Ghino tembe ŋgoreiyeva, wo ya vaitoŋga vaito regha na thoŋgo hu wogiya ghathombe e ghino, ghino tembe ŋgoreiyeva ne ya utuŋa e ghemi ya vata thela ele mbaro vwatae na ya vakathaŋgiya bigibigike thiyake.
Jon le rɨghe na i bapɨtaiso, i mena weya Loi o i mena weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ?” Mbe thiye eŋge thɨ veutu weŋgi, thɨŋa, “Thoŋgo raŋa, ‘I mena weya Loi’ ne iŋa, ‘Buda kaiwae na mava hu loŋweghathɨgha Jon?’
Ko thoŋgo raŋa, ‘I mena weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ,’ ra mararuŋgiya gharɨgharɨ, kaiwae thɨ ghareghare Jon iye Loi ghalɨŋae gharautu.”
Iya kaiwae thɨ gonjogha weya Jisas, thɨŋa, “Ma wo ghareghare.” I dage weŋgi, iŋa, “Ghino tembe ŋgoreiyeva, mane ya utuŋa e ghemi, ya vata thela e vwatae na ya vakathaŋgiya bigibigike thiyake.”
Jisas i utuŋa amala le ŋgaŋga thenjighewo utuninji
Jisas i gotubwe iŋa, “Ŋgoroŋga lemi renuwaŋa? Amala regha le ŋgaŋga thenjighewo. I wa weya virɨviva na ve dagewe, iŋa ‘Naruŋgu, noroke u wa na vo kaiwo e uma.’
I gonjogha weya ramae iŋa, ‘Ya botewo,’ ko va muyai i vɨva le renuwaŋa na i wa.
Amalama i wa weya nariyema regha na ve dagewe tembe ŋgoreiyeva me dage weya virɨvivama. Nariyema iŋa, ‘Ŋgoreiye Bwebwe, tene ya wa,’ ko iyemaeŋge ma va i wa.

Thenjighewoko, thela i vakatha ŋgoreiya ramanji le renuwaŋa?” Thɨŋa, “Iya virɨvivama.” Jisas i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Ya dage emunjoru e ghemi, takis gharamban na wanakau thɨ mbana riwanji modae, thiye hu rerenuwaŋa kaero thɨ vurɨmban Loi le ghamba mbaro e ghakamwathɨ. Valɨkaiwanjiya ne thɨ ru ko iyemaeŋge ghemi mane hu ru.

Kaiwae Jon Rabapɨtaiso va i mena weŋga, i vaghareŋga thanavu thovuye ghakamwathɨ na ma hu loŋweghathɨ, ko takis gharamban na wanakau thɨ mbana riwanji modae, thiye eŋge thɨ loŋweghathɨ. Othembe va hu thuweŋgi thɨ vakatha ŋgoreiyako, ko mava hu vɨva ghamithanavu na hu loŋweghathɨgha Jon le utuko.”
Uma gharanjimbunjimbu raraitharɨ

Jisas iŋa, “Mbowo ya utuŋava goghaimba regha na hu loŋwe: Lolo regha va i kabu waen ghauma, i gana vaghɨliya, i vakatha doda waen ghamba i imbɨimbɨ, na i vatada ŋgolo regha, umako gharanjimbunjimbu lenji ghamba yaku. I vakatha ŋgoreiyako, amba i vatomwe weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ vavana na thɨ vakaiwoŋa amalaghɨniye kaiwae. Na amalaghɨniye i wa e valɨvaŋga regha.
“Mbaŋa kaero ghambaŋa thɨ vu, umama tanuwagae i variyeŋgiya le rakakaiwo weŋgiya umama gharanjimbunjimbu na vethɨ mbana uneune amalaghɨniye kaiwae.
Umama gharanjimbunjimbu thiya laweŋgiya rakakaiwoma, thɨ ŋgeŋgeŋa regha, thɨ tagavamara regha na thɨ biriya regha e varɨ.
Amalama mbowo i variyeŋgiva le rakakaiwo vavana, seiwo i kivwala me vivama. Thɨ vakatha weŋgi tembe ŋgoreiyeva methɨ vivama.
Muyai moli i variya nariye weŋgi na iŋa, ‘Ne thɨ yavwatatawana naruŋguke.’
Ko mbaŋa ranjimbunjimbuma thɨ thuweya nariyeko, thɨŋa, ‘Umake tanuwagae nariya iyako. Amalaghɨniye ne i rombaroŋa umake ramae e ghereiye. Hu mena ra tagavamare na mbalama ra mbaroŋava iya le umake.’
Thɨ yalawe, thɨ wokiyathuraŋgiya e gana ghereiye na thɨ tagavamare.”
Jisas i vaitoŋgi iŋa, “Mbaŋa ne umama tanuwagae i njoghama, ne i vakatha budakai weŋgiya umako gharanjimbunjimbu?”

Jiu lenji randevivaŋgima thɨŋa, “Ne i gaboŋgiya gharɨgharɨko raraitharɨ na i vatomweya le umako weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ totogha thɨ njimbukiki, mbala i mweghe na thɨ vu, thɨ vakatha wagiyawe uneuneko amalaghɨniye kaiwae na vethɨ giyawe.”
Jisas i dage weŋgi, iŋa, “Mbe hu ndevaona mun ŋgoroŋga Buk Boboma iŋa?

content.text: Varɨke iya ŋgoloke gharavatavatad va thɨ botewo na i tabo mbaghɨmbaghɨ.
Iyake Giya le vakatha, na ghathuwathuwa i thovuye na i wo nuwanda.”

content: Jisas mbowo i dageva weŋgi iŋa, “Ya dage e ghemi, Loi ne i wo le ghamba mbarona ghathovuye weŋga na i wogiya weŋgiya the vanautuma gharɨgharɨniye iya ne e yawalinjiko uneune i woraŋgiya i thovuyeŋa Loi le ghamba mbaro.
Thela ne i dobu e varɨke iyake vwatae ne i tagamunumunuwo, na thoŋgo varɨke iyake i dobu lolo regha e vwatae ne i tagavwathavwatha.”
Mbaŋa ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye na Parisi thɨ loŋweya Jisas le goghaimbaŋgiko, thɨ ghareghare i utuutu thiye kaiwanji.
Thɨ mando na thɨ munjeva thɨ yalawe ko iyemaeŋge thɨ mararuŋgiya wabwiko kaiwae thɨŋa iye Loi ghalɨŋae gharautu.
